# 0xFLOW

> Founder-led product studio. From validated idea to production, end to end.

0xFLOW is Hrithik Nayak's software studio. It takes products from a validated concept to a production-ready V1, and builds custom internal software, AI tools, and workflow automation for established businesses.

## Key Resources

- [Full Website Content](https://oxflow.studio/llms-full.txt): A complete markdown representation of the site, including services, process, and case studies.
- [Case Study: Creator OS](https://oxflow.studio/work/creator-os): The financial back office for creators, built as founding engineer for Everbloom.
- [Case Study: Astro Dadi](https://oxflow.studio/work/astro-dadi): A live consumer AI product for Vedic astrology, built and operated solo.
- [Contact](mailto:hrithik@oxflow.studio): Or book a fit call from the website.

## Services

- **Product builds**: Validated concept to production V1, including auth, payments, and AI.
- **Internal software and AI tools**: Custom tools for established businesses.
- **Workflow automation**: n8n or Zapier where that is enough, owned code where it is not.
